name: Screen-reader users can identify each team flag in the bracket and group standings
description: A non-sighted user navigating with a screen reader can tell which team or country each flag image represents — every flag image in the homepage bracket and the groups standings exposes a non-empty text alternative.

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the knockout bracket section
